purpose: Durable work queue for the language-neutral Date::Manip English specification.

scope.included: Reference research, API accounting, original English Gherkin features, observations, coverage review, and a verified Perl/Date::Manip BDD harness and adapter.
scope.excluded: A future non-Perl implementation and any transfer of upstream source, copied tests/data, translated algorithms, or Perl binding code to it.

coordination.rule: Only the coordinator changes this queue or the checkpoint. Contributors report evidence and proposed status changes to the coordinator.

baseline.meaning: The repository planning baseline is available; this is not a completed project work batch.

batches.title: Establish the reproducible reference profiles
outputs: Named DM6 and DM5 compatibility profiles
acceptance: Exact Date::Manip release or commit, archive hash, Perl/runtime details, locale, timezone, reference time, configuration sources, and timezone-data identifiers are recorded.
Repeated isolated probes have reproducible results for each profile.
Reference setup does not depend on a Perl BDD runner, step definitions, or adapter.
batches.review: Coordinator repeated all three profiles, verified script hashes, and independently checked leap-day and weekday facts. DM5 has distinct 5.66 API version and no claimed DM6 timezone-data identifier.

batches.title: Reconcile callable and source-side API inventory
outputs: Stable public contract IDs and generic-operation mappings
Recorded dispositions for private, generated, compatibility, tooling, and data-only entries
acceptance: Documentation, exports, inheritance, aliases, generated symbols, runtime callability, and declarations are reconciled against the pinned reference.
Every inventory row has a visible disposition; each public operation has a portable mapping or a stated exclusion.
No completeness claim is derived solely from scenario counts.
batches.review: All423 declaration identities,164 public bindings,96 generic IDs,153 inherited routes and both facade exports reconciled. Five contract catalogues plus date/DM5/delta/language/config syntax inventories give explicit method and auxiliary partition obligations. This is inventory completeness, not observed behavioral coverage; source-derived predictions remain unapproved until probes and review.

batches.title: Specify interpretation, rendering, and calendar-query behavior
acceptance: Cases cover success, boundaries, invalid input, options, result variants, and relevant state.
Each promoted expectation has isolated reference evidence, profile, and semantic disposition.
Feature text remains language-neutral.
batches.progress: Calendar batch retained. New parsing corpus: 291 repeated binding cases, 283 authored candidate literals checked against saved evidence, 8 legacy configuration exceptions separate. Rendering worker revised 24 repeated invocations and draft features; coordinator review pending. Pattern parsing assigned; remaining natural-language/time/language and calendar partitions open.

batches.title: Specify dates, deltas, durations, and arithmetic behavior
acceptance: Cases include calendar versus elapsed semantics, limits, invalid input, return variants, and DST interactions where applicable.
Each promoted expectation has isolated reference evidence, profile, and semantic disposition.
Feature text remains language-neutral.
batches.progress: First 59-case batch corrected for explicit options, field order and semantic labels. Worker now expanding all delta productions, fields/ranges and OO operand/mode variants. Review remains pending.

batches.title: Specify recurrence syntax, modifiers, and occurrence behavior
acceptance: Cases cover supported forms, limits, no-match and invalid conventions, modifiers, and ordered-result behavior.
Each promoted expectation has isolated reference evidence, profile, and semantic disposition.
Feature text remains language-neutral.
batches.progress: Coordinator committed corrected 31-case/35-ID draft with concrete lifecycle assertions and repeatability checks. Worker now expanding frequency grammar, setters, modifiers and range/attempt limits.

batches.title: Specify timezones, business calendars, holidays, and events
outputs: Zone, business-rule, holiday, and event partitions
acceptance: Cases cover DST gaps and overlaps, zone resolution, customization, business-day rules, holidays/events, and environment-dependent dispositions.
Each promoted expectation has isolated reference evidence, profile, and semantic disposition.
Feature text remains language-neutral.
batches.progress: Worker returned 33 repeated cases sampling all 23 operation IDs, including non-whole-hour wrappers and error controls. None of the broad partitions is discharged; review and further boundaries remain.

batches.title: Specify configuration and observable object/value lifecycle behavior
outputs: Configuration, mutation, context, and error-channel partitions
acceptance: Cases isolate configuration and backend state, distinguish absent/empty/invalid/no-match results, and cover observable lifecycle transitions.
Each promoted expectation has isolated reference evidence, profile, and semantic disposition.
Feature text remains language-neutral.
batches.progress: Worker returned 40 repeated cases narrowly sampling all 38 configuration keys plus lifecycle cases. Observer-induced unset-value errors corrected. Feature/evidence review and broader domains remain.

batches.title: Audit specification coverage and prepare the reviewed English handoff
outputs: Coverage report by capability, partition, profile, directive, language, configuration, and state
Visible dispositions for gaps, skips, unsupported variants, and disputed cases
Reviewed export set limited to original portable English materials
acceptance: Every in-scope public operation has direct behavioral coverage and every private declaration has an indirect mapping or reviewed exclusion. Binding-only and unsupported operations have explicit, justified dispositions; deferred or unobserved in-scope work prevents completion.
Coverage denominators retain skipped, unsupported, and disputed entries.
The handoff excludes upstream source/tests/data, translated algorithms, and Perl binding code.

batches.title: Review and freeze the portable English specification
outputs: Review dispositions for ambiguities, disputed cases, and compatibility profiles
Frozen literal expectations for adapter use
acceptance: Every feature assertion has an approved semantic meaning and reviewed literal expectation.
The review confirms that portable features contain no implementation-language code or translated upstream algorithm.
Source-separation requirements are recorded before Perl binding work begins.
No required capability or partition remains merely proposed, unobserved, or deferred. Genuine environment-dependent profiles have executable specified checks or an explicit user-scope disposition.

batches.title: Establish the Perl BDD runner and harness conventions
outputs: Original harness layout and execution documentation
Runner trial covering feature parsing, outlines, tables, tags, Unicode, escaping, and failure reporting
acceptance: The runner executes the approved feature grammar and a deliberately failing assertion demonstrates test sensitivity.
README records exact installation and run commands.
Dependency licensing and provenance are recorded without bundling upstream Date::Manip material.

batches.title: Implement the original Perl/Date::Manip BDD adapter
outputs: Original Perl step definitions and adapter
acceptance: Steps call the separately installed Date::Manip dependency and assert frozen literals rather than calculate expectations with the operation under test.
The adapter preserves observable errors, state, ordering, scalar/list context, and undef/empty/zero distinctions.
No Date::Manip algorithm, upstream test, or upstream source is copied into the adapter.

batches.title: Run and report the complete Perl BDD suite
outputs: Recorded Perl and Date::Manip versions, commands, skips, and remaining gaps
Final source-separation audit for the portable export
acceptance: Relevant tests and the full suite pass, with any skips or unsupported variants explicitly reported.
Results distinguish executable BDD verification from planning/documentation checks.
The final portable handoff remains limited to approved original English materials and excludes Perl binding artifacts.
